div.head: Iud Dei XIII 1.1
div.ab: Accipe illos homines quos in uoluntate habes mittere in aquam et duc eos in ęcclesiam; et coram omnibus illis cantet presbyter missam, sicut mos est; et faciat eos ad ipsam missam offerre.

div.ab: Take those men whom you have it in mind to send into the water and lead them into the church; and before all of them let the priest sing mass, as is the custom; and let him make them make an offering at that mass.
